CSDRR1.label: Indexing Status Issues

CSDRR1.1.label: Content Not Yet Indexed
CSDRR1.1.description: Cases where content is either under review, not yet published, or has not been indexed due to various reasons.

CSDRR1.2.label: Source Coverage Issues
CSDRR1.2.description: Issues related to the source's eligibility for indexing, including discontinued coverage or re-evaluation status.

CSDRR1.3.label: Content Already Indexed
CSDRR1.3.description: Requests or inquiries regarding content that is already indexed in Scopus, including updates or corrections.

CSDRR1.4.label: Journal Re-evaluation
CSDRR1.4.description: Cases where journals are undergoing re-evaluation, affecting their indexing status and future content addition.

CSDRR1.5.label: Other Indexing Status Issues
CSDRR1.5.description: Cases that fall within indexing status but do not fit any specific leaf above.

CSDRR1.description: This category covers issues related to the current status of content indexing in Scopus, including reasons for delays or denials.

CSDRR2.label: Content Type and Eligibility

CSDRR2.1.label: Ineligible Content Types
CSDRR2.1.description: Requests regarding content types that are not covered for indexing, such as book reviews or non-serial conference material.

CSDRR2.2.label: Content Format Issues
CSDRR2.2.description: Issues related to the format of the content, such as content not displayed as a full article or not found on the publisher's site.

CSDRR2.3.label: Publication Timing Issues
CSDRR2.3.description: Concerns regarding the timing of publication and its impact on indexing, including content published outside coverage years.

CSDRR2.4.label: Other Content Type Issues
CSDRR2.4.description: Cases that fall within content type and eligibility but do not fit any specific leaf above.

CSDRR2.description: This category addresses issues related to the type of content submitted for indexing and its eligibility under Scopus policies.

CSDRR3.label: Request Processing and Follow-up

CSDRR3.1.label: Request Under Review
CSDRR3.1.description: Requests that are currently being reviewed, including those awaiting confirmation or further action.

CSDRR3.2.label: Status Inquiries
CSDRR3.2.description: Inquiries where customers ask for the status of their requests without providing actionable requests.

CSDRR3.3.label: Duplicate Requests
CSDRR3.3.description: Cases where duplicate tickets have been submitted for the same issue.

CSDRR3.4.label: Other Request Processing Issues
CSDRR3.4.description: Cases that fall within request processing but do not fit any specific leaf above.

CSDRR3.description: This category includes issues related to the processing of requests and follow-up actions taken by Scopus.

CSDRR4.label: Correction and Update Requests

CSDRR4.1.label: Correction Requests
CSDRR4.1.description: Requests for corrections to indexed content, including citation corrections and updates to author profiles.

CSDRR4.2.label: Update Requests
CSDRR4.2.description: Requests for updates on content that is already indexed, including status updates on articles in press.

CSDRR4.3.label: Other Correction and Update Issues
CSDRR4.3.description: Cases that fall within correction and update requests but do not fit any specific leaf above.

CSDRR4.description: This category covers requests related to corrections or updates needed for indexed content.
